cases.description: Two independent sources give incompatible main-span lengths for the same bridge with no difference in time or definition.

documents.title: Varnholt Bridge turns 35
documents.author: Petra Lindqvist
documents.text: The Varnholt Bridge across the Lessing River opened to traffic in 1987. Its main span measures 412 metres between the two towers. The bridge carries about 31,000 vehicles on an average weekday.

documents.title: Major Structures Inventory 2023
documents.text: The Varnholt Bridge is a cable-stayed crossing completed in 1987. The main span between the towers is 388 metres long. Inspections in 2022 found no structural defects in the stay cables.

cases.description: A drug reduces migraine days in adults but not in children; the populations are stated explicitly, so this is not a contradiction.

documents.title: Fenoral for migraine prevention in adults: a randomised controlled trial
documents.author: Henrik Aaberg
documents.text: In a randomised trial of 340 adults aged 18 to 65, daily fenoral reduced monthly migraine days by 2.1 compared with placebo. The reduction was statistically significant after twelve weeks. Mild nausea was the most common side effect.

documents.title: Fenoral in paediatric migraine: a randomised trial
documents.author: Clara Mendonca
documents.text: A separate randomised trial enrolled 180 children aged 6 to 12 with frequent migraine. In children, fenoral produced no significant reduction in monthly migraine days compared with placebo. The authors note that paediatric dosing was lower than in adult studies.

cases.description: A budget article states a percentage increase that does not match its own figures (40 to 46 million is 15 percent, not 20 percent).

documents.title: Halvorsen council passes 2024 budget
documents.author: Mikkel Strand
documents.text: The city of Halvorsen approved its 2024 budget on Tuesday. Spending on schools rose from 40 million euros to 46 million euros, an increase of 20 percent. Road maintenance received 12 million euros, the same as in the previous year. The council said the additional school spending was funded by higher property tax receipts.

documents.text: A new field study has bad news for pollinators. Its lead author, Ines Calder, wrote "We found that clothiazine reduces wild bee numbers at field-realistic doses." Farmers in the valley should stop using it immediately.

cases.description: An observational comparison of schools with confounders is used to conclude that tablets cause better reading.

documents.title: Digital Devices and Literacy: 2022 Review
documents.text: The trust compared reading scores in 48 primary schools during the 2022 school year. Schools that gave every pupil a tablet scored on average 8 points higher on the reading assessment than schools that did not. The tablet schools were also located in wealthier districts and had smaller classes. These results show that providing tablets improves children's reading.
